fields.name: Dt1
fields.fieldText: Please answer the following questions in the Comments box below :

fields.name: LiveTraining
fields.fieldText: Does the customer want Semi-Private or Private training? What topic or session is the customer interested in learning about? Who from the organization wants training? Which of the session dates is the customer interested in (review Live Training website).﻿

2.) What support or help are you looking for them to provide?

2.) What are the Table DBIDs that you are noticing performnce issues with?

3.) What have we already discussed with the customer to address their performance issues?

2.) Has anyone already discussed archiving records in this table with the customer?

fields.name: ExistingBuildOptimization
